agent_role: You are the lead implementation agent for the Bay-Max repository. Your job is to convert Iteration 009 from component-complete to fully runtime-wired and verified. Fix the remaining affect integration gaps, run proof-oriented verification, normalize reports/docs/version metadata, commit, and push.

iteration_context.previous_iteration_status: Iteration 009 added affect analysis backends, smoothing, planner bias, prompt integration, safety gating, docs, and tests. However, live runtime wiring and real local affect verification are still incomplete.
iteration_context.current_goal: Make affect analysis truly active in the live runtime, prove it with replay/local artifacts, and fix metadata/doc drift so the branch is trustworthy.

actual_gaps_to_fix: Live runtime does not clearly initialize/use the affect analyzer and smoother in the continuous frame loop.
Live runtime status path does not clearly populate affect fields even though schemas expose them.
Replay/local affect verification has not been run with real face samples; current evidence is mostly automated tests.
.env.example does not expose affect settings even though settings.py does.
pyproject.toml version metadata and report/manifest metadata need normalization.
design_requirements: Keep affect as a soft tone-adaptation signal, not a clinical inference engine.
Use the existing affect backend abstraction; do not switch away from MediaPipe unless needed for compatibility.
Use existing detected/recognized face regions where possible; avoid duplicating face detection work.
Run affect analysis at a lower cadence than face tracking using the configured sample-every-n-frames setting.
Apply smoothing before planner influence and before memory writes.
If confidence is low or no face is usable, return unknown/none rather than guessing.
Live runtime overlay/debug output must show affect values when available.
Artifacts must prove what was inferred, when, and why.
required_code_changes: Wire the affect analyzer and affect smoother into src/baymax/live/runtime.py end-to-end.
Initialize the analyzer from settings and keep graceful fallback behavior if unavailable.
On eligible analysis frames, extract/use a face region and run affect analysis.
Update live runtime status with valence, arousal, affect confidence, backend, and stable duration.
Expose affect information in overlay/debug output so local testers can see it live or in replay.
Ensure planner input in the live path receives the smoothed affect state.
Ensure memory/consolidation path can receive stable affect summaries from live sessions without per-frame spam.
Add artifact logging for affect samples, stable affect changes, and affect-driven response decisions.
Add or update a replay/local verification script for affect behavior using images or short clips.
Keep all existing safety gating against clinical language.

required_api_behavior.expectation: Return affect fields that reflect actual runtime values, not just schema defaults.
Continue to report available backends and active configuration accurately.

must_capture: runtime status snapshots showing affect fields
annotated frames or screenshots with affect overlay when possible
whether planner strategy changed due to affect
whether any affect memory candidate was created or intentionally suppressed

tasks.title: Audit and patch runtime integration
actions: Read the current live runtime, live schemas, emotion backend, smoother, planner, and memory consolidation code.
Identify exactly where affect is missing from the live analysis loop and status propagation.
Wire the affect analyzer and smoother into the live runtime without breaking existing perception flow.
acceptance_criteria: Live runtime actively runs affect analysis on eligible frames when enabled.
No regression in face recognition, pose, speech, or dialogue paths.

tasks.title: Populate status, overlay, and event logs
actions: Update LiveRuntimeStatus population so affect fields reflect real values.
Add affect info to overlay/debug HUD and any status APIs that expose runtime state.
Log meaningful affect events or stable-state transitions to artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A local tester can see valence/arousal/confidence/backend/stable-duration in runtime outputs.
Artifact logs clearly show when affect changed or was unavailable.

tasks.title: Confirm planner and memory integration from live runtime
actions: Ensure the live runtime passes smoothed affect state into the planner path used for responses.
Ensure affect only biases tone when confidence threshold is met.
Ensure stable affect summaries can enter session consolidation while single-frame noise is suppressed.
acceptance_criteria: At least one verification case demonstrates affect-aware strategy/tone selection or explicitly shows no change when confidence is low.
Memory writes remain gated and non-clinical.

tasks.title: Run proof-oriented replay and local verification
actions: Add or update a replay/local verification script for affect analysis.
Use at least one neutral-looking sample and one clearly positive/expressive sample if available locally.
If local webcam testing is possible, run at least one live test outside Sol; otherwise run replay tests and report the limitation honestly.
Save all outputs under artifacts/verification_0091/.
acceptance_criteria: There is real non-test proof that runtime affect fields update on actual images or replay frames.
If live webcam testing is not possible, replay-based proof exists and the blocker is explicitly stated.

tasks.title: Fix report, config, and version parity
actions: Add affect env vars to .env.example.
Normalize pyproject version metadata to match the intended project state for this hotfix.
Replace placeholder latest_commit_sha values in reports with real SHAs.
Ensure README/ROADMAP/ARCHITECTURE/MODEL_STACK/EMOTION_ARCHITECTURE/LOCAL_TESTING/project_state.json reflect the actual implemented state and remaining blockers.
acceptance_criteria: Docs and metadata match the code and branch state.
No placeholder commit SHA remains in the final report.

tasks.title: Regression tests, report, commit, and push
actions: Run the full automated test suite and lint.
Add focused tests for live-runtime affect propagation/status/update logic if coverage is missing.
Write reports/iteration-009.md and reports/iteration-009.json updates describing the hotfix truthfully.
Commit and push the hotfix branch.
acceptance_criteria: Report clearly separates automated, replay, and true live-webcam evidence.

manual_verification_expectations.expected: valence near neutral or low confidence; no exaggerated bias
higher positive valence than the neutral sample or a clearly different affect state
unknown/unavailable affect; no false confident output
tone/strategy only changes when confidence threshold is met; no clinical claim
status endpoint/overlay shows actual affect values changing over time

must_run: python -m ruff check src/ apps/ tests/ scripts/
must_add_or_update_tests_for: planner bias from smoothed affect in a live/runtime path
honesty_rules: Do not claim live webcam affect works unless you ran it on a machine with a real camera.
Do not claim Py-Feat backend works if only MediaPipe was used.
Do not fake screenshots, overlays, or artifact contents.
If replay/local samples are synthetic or hand-picked, state that clearly.

definition_of_done: Affect is genuinely wired into the live runtime.
Runtime status and overlay reflect affect values when available.
Planner sees smoothed affect state from the live path.
Replay/local verification artifacts prove the feature is active.
.env.example, pyproject, reports, and docs are normalized.
Automated tests pass and hotfix branch is pushed.
